summary: Rung 2 review follow-up: tightened .claude/settings.json's two dotnet allow-list entries from broad wildcards to 4+4 exact per-test-project entries (Claude Code docs confirm a bare * in a Bash rule matches arbitrary text across slashes/spaces, not one path segment, so the prior entries were looser than described); trimmed docs/ROUTED_CONCERNS.md's control-transfer row to drop an inferred clause not literally in its source decision doc.
